annotations.title: Find hotels by name or place

description: Find hotels by name or place with a semantic text search. Returns up to 5 matches (set `limit` for more) with name, address, city, country and a relevance score. Check the name and city before using an `id`. For an exact hotel name, `get_data_hotels` with `hotelName` and `cityName` or `countryCode` is more precise.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: The semantic search query (e.g. 'Burj Jumeirah Dubai').

name: get_data_hotel_search
title: Find hotels by name or place
